title: Sr Advanced Cyber Security Architect/Engineer
jobDescription: Job Summary The Senior Cyber Security Engineer is a senior technical leader within the Security Operations function, responsible for advanced analytics, complex investigations, tool engineering, and driving SOC capability maturity. This role proactively identifies and responds to sophisticated threats, advances detection capabilities, and guides the SOC toward higher automation, intelligence‑driven operations, and continuous improvement aligned with industry best practices and Gartner L4 maturity. JOB DUTIES: Continuously assess emerging threats and evaluate SOC tools, architectures, and workflows for improvement. Recommend and implement standardized, scalable approaches for SOC technologies and processes. Develop and enhance SLAs, KPIs, and operational reporting for security tooling and SOC effectiveness. Maintain and enhance SOC policies, documentation, and procedures. Lead identification, investigation, and remediation of advanced security events and incidents. Ensure audit trails and evidence-handling standards support incident investigation and regulatory requirements. Develop cybersecurity policies and DLP standards aligned with organizational risk posture. Manage and investigate data‑loss events to ensure risks are mitigated. Execute and enforce security policy, exception management, and risk controls. Provide Tier 3 technical escalation support for SOC incidents and engineering issues. Collaborate closely with architecture, network, data center, HR, Legal, and third parties during investigations. Lead and contribute to complex cybersecurity and SOC modernization projects. Mentor and develop SOC engineers and analysts to strengthen capabilities. Provide leadership input into planning, deployment, and optimization of new and existing security initiatives. Lead SIEM, SOAR, and XDR engineering, correlation rule development, and detection content optimization. Drive automation design and orchestration to increase SOC efficiency and reduce response times. Lead deep‑dive threat hunting, hypothesis‑driven investigations, and adversary simulation. Guide cloud‑native security monitoring and detection engineering. YOU MUST HAVE: Minimum 8+ years of cybersecurity or SOC experience. Excellent documentation and communication skills. Certifications: GSEC, Security+, CISSP (preferred or in progress). Deep understanding of network protocols, IDS/IPS, SIEM, firewalls, proxies, and DLP technologies. Strong understanding of incident response frameworks and advanced threat actor behaviors. Ability to prioritize in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment. WE VALUE: Experience with modern SOC engineering (SOAR automation, XDR implementation, cloud monitoring). Strong experience developing detection rules, tuning alerts, and engineering log ingestion pipelines. Proven ability to lead investigations involving advanced persistent threats (APTs). Additional certifications (GCIA, GCFE, GDAT, GCTI, etc.). WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: Support global SOC operations. Opportunities for advanced training, conferences, and continuous professional development. Reports to: Cyber Security Director. title: Sr Advanced Systems Administrator - Saviynt Admin
jobDescription: The Senior Saviynt Expert plays a critical role within the Enterprise Identity & Access Management (IAM) Team, taking responsibility for architecting, implementing, and supporting the organization's Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform. This position focuses on identity lifecycle management, access governance, application onboarding, role-based access control (RBAC), certification campaigns, and compliance to ensure secure and efficient identity management across the enterprise. Success in this position depends on strong technical expertise, self-direction, analytical thinking, and proactive problem-solving skills to optimize identity processes, strengthen security controls, and enhance the user access experience. JOB DUTIES: Design, implement, and configure Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) solutions for Identity Governance & Administration (IGA). Configure and manage identity lifecycle processes (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) integrated with HR systems such as Workday, Oracle HCM, or SAP SuccessFactors. Implement RBAC, birthright access, entitlement-based provisioning, access governance, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls. Integrate Saviynt with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), SAP, ServiceNow, databases, and cloud/on-premises applications using REST, SCIM, JDBC, and other connectors. Configure and customize Saviynt connectors, provisioning workflows, approval policies, password policies, and business rules. Perform SC2 server installation, troubleshooting, and configure scheduled jobs using the Saviynt Job Control Panel. Provide L2/L3 production support for provisioning, access requests, certifications, campaigns, and connector/API-related issues. Troubleshoot platform issues using Saviynt logs, SQL-based Data Analyzer, and perform health checks, upgrades, and patch validations. Manage access request workflows, certification campaigns, compliance reporting, and audit support activities. Collaborate with IAM architects, application owners, security teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver IAM solutions. Develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and operational guides. YOU MUST HAVE: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC). Strong knowledge of Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) concepts, including Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), RBAC, SoD, access certifications, and entitlement management. Experience integrating Saviynt with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), ServiceNow, SAP systems, and enterprise applications. Hands-on experience with Saviynt connectors, including AD, Azure AD, REST, JDBC, and SCIM. Strong SQL skills with experience using Saviynt Data Analyzer. Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and application integrations. Good understanding of authentication and security concepts such as SSO, MFA, and LDAP. Experience providing L2/L3 production support, troubleshooting, and incident management. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. title: Sr Advanced Systems Administrator - AD Expert
jobDescription: Senior Active Directory Expert plays a critical role within the Enterprise Infrastructure IT Team, taking responsibility for architecting, managing, and supporting the organization's Active Directory services across global environments. This position focuses on Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Azure AD/Entra ID integration, Group Policy, identity and access management, DNS, DHCP, and authentication services to ensure a secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise infrastructure JOB DUTIES: Administer and support enterprise Microsoft Active Directory across multiple domains and forests. Manage Domain Controllers, DNS, Sites & Services, FSMO roles, and trust relationships. Monitor AD health, replication, authentication, and perform L3 troubleshooting and root cause analysis. Plan and execute Active Directory upgrades, migrations, domain consolidations, and disaster recovery activities. Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Azure AD Connect in a hybrid identity environment. Configure and troubleshoot Azure AD Connect synchronization, synchronization rules, filtering, and staging servers. Manage Enterprise Applications, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect integrations. Implement and maintain Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access Policies, Identity Protection, and Zero Trust security controls. Design, implement, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and security baselines. Develop and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts, modules, and automation solutions for Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and IAM operations. Manage Microsoft 365 and Entra ID licensing, automate license assignments, and generate compliance reports. Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and participate in on-call support and major incident management. YOU MUST HAVE: 8–10 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Active Directory administration (Windows Server 2016/2019/2022). Strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Azure AD Connect. Experience managing Domain Controllers, AD replication, DNS, DHCP, Kerberos, LDAP, and Group Policy. Proven experience handling L2/L3 support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis in enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of Identity & Access Management (IAM), MFA, Conditional Access, RBAC, and SSO technologies. Advanced PowerShell scripting skills with experience in automation, reporting, and Microsoft Graph PowerShell modules. Experience administering Microsoft 365 licensing and hybrid identity environments. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. WE VALUE: Experience with Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Identity Governance. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API and automation frameworks. Experience with enterprise Active Directory migrations and domain consolidation projects. ITIL process knowledge and experience working in large enterprise or managed services environments. Proactive mindset with a strong focus on automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale hybrid identity and Microsoft cloud technologies. Exposure to cutting-edge Microsoft Entra ID, Identity & Access Management. Hands-on experience with automation, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph to drive operational efficiency. Opportunity to lead complex L3/L4 troubleshooting, migrations, and modernization projects. Collaborative work environment with opportunities to enhance technical expertise and career growth.
